title: Clean a whole folder in one go

steps.note: The native folder dialog is never opened by a story or an e2e test.

action.gesture: drop a folder on the window

steps.note: No story or e2e test performs a real drop; e2e sends the file-open-add-files IPC instead.

action.gesture: the supported files of the folder arrive as rows under one folder row

e2e.test: reports one skipped unsupported file and processes supported files from a nested folder

steps.note: Shown present and named; no e2e expands or collapses a folder row.
